title: अंश २ · अध्याय १०

items.speaker: श्रीपराशर उवाच
items.text:
त्र्यशीतिमण्डलशतं काष्ठयोरन्तरं द्वयोः
आरोहणावरोहाभ्यां भानोरब्देन या गतिः
स रथोधिष्ठितो देवैरादित्यै ऋषिभिस्तथा
गन्धर्वैरप्सरोभिश्च ग्रामणीसर्पराक्षसैः
धाता क्रतुस्थला चैव पुलस्त्यो वासुकिस्तथा
रथभृद्ग्रामणीर्हेतिस्तुम्बुरुश्चैव सप्तमः
items.tr:
tryaśītimaṇḍalaśataṃ kāṣṭhayorantaraṃ dvayoḥ
ārohaṇāvarohābhyāṃ bhānorabdena yā gatiḥ
sa rathodhiṣṭhito devairādityai ṛṣibhistathā
gandharvairapsarobhiśca grāmaṇīsarparākṣasaiḥ
dhātā kratusthalā caiva pulastyo vāsukistathā
rathabhṛdgrāmaṇīrhetistumburuścaiva saptamaḥ

items.text:
एते वसन्ति वै चैत्रे मधुमासे सदैव हि
मैत्रेय स्यन्दने भानोः सप्तमासाधिकारिणः
अर्यमा पुलहश्चैव रथौजाः पुञ्जिकस्थला
प्रहेतिः कच्छवीरश्व नारदश्च रथे रवेः
माधवे निवसन्त्येते शुचिसंज्ञे निबोध मे
मित्रोत्रिस्तक्षको रक्षः पौरुषेयोथ मेनका
items.tr:
ete vasanti vai caitre madhumāse sadaiva hi
maitreya syandane bhānoḥ saptamāsādhikāriṇaḥ
aryamā pulahaścaiva rathaujāḥ puñjikasthalā
prahetiḥ kacchavīraśva nāradaśca rathe raveḥ
mādhave nivasantyete śucisaṃjñe nibodha me
mitrotristakṣako rakṣaḥ pauruṣeyotha menakā

items.text:
हाहा रथस्वनश्चैव मैत्रेयैते वसन्ति वै
वरुणो वसिष्ठो रम्भा च सहजन्या हुहूरथः
रथचित्रस्तथा शुक्रे वसन्त्याषाढसंज्ञके
इन्द्रो विश्वासुः स्रोता एलापुत्रस्तथांगिराः
प्रम्लोचा च नभस्येते सप्तिश्चार्के वसन्ति वै
विवस्वानुग्रसेनश्च भृगुरापूरणस्तथा
items.tr:
hāhā rathasvanaścaiva maitreyaite vasanti vai
varuṇo vasiṣṭho rambhā ca sahajanyā huhūrathaḥ
rathacitrastathā śukre vasantyāṣāḍhasaṃjñake
indro viśvāsuḥ srotā elāputrastathāṃgirāḥ
pramlocā ca nabhasyete saptiścārke vasanti vai
vivasvānugrasenaśca bhṛgurāpūraṇastathā

items.text:
अनुम्लोचा शंखपालो व्याघ्रो भाद्र पदे तथा
पूषा च सुरुचिर्वातो गौतमोथ धनञ्जयः
सुषेणोऽन्यो घृताची च वसन्त्याश्वयुजे रवौ
विश्वावसुर्भरद्वाजः पर्जन्यैरावतौ तथा
विश्वाची सेनजिच्चापि कार्त्तिके च वसन्ति वै
अंशः काश्यपतार्क्ष्यास्तु महापद्मस्तथोर्वशी
items.tr:
anumlocā śaṃkhapālo vyāghro bhādra pade tathā
pūṣā ca surucirvāto gautamotha dhanañjayaḥ
suṣeṇo'nyo ghṛtācī ca vasantyāśvayuje ravau
viśvāvasurbharadvājaḥ parjanyairāvatau tathā
viśvācī senajiccāpi kārttike ca vasanti vai
aṃśaḥ kāśyapatārkṣyāstu mahāpadmastathorvaśī

items.text:
चित्रसेनस्तथा विद्युन्मार्गशीर्षेधिकारिणः
क्रतुर्भगस्तथोर्णायुः स्फूर्जः कार्कोटकस्तथा
अरिष्टनेमिश्चैवान्या पूर्वाचित्तिर्वराप्सराः
पौषमासे वसन्त्येते सप्तभास्करमण्डले
लोकप्रकाशनार्थाय विग्रवर्याधिकारिणः
त्वष्टाथ जमदग्निश्च कम्बलोथ तिलोत्तमा
items.tr:
citrasenastathā vidyunmārgaśīrṣedhikāriṇaḥ
kraturbhagastathorṇāyuḥ sphūrjaḥ kārkoṭakastathā
ariṣṭanemiścaivānyā pūrvācittirvarāpsarāḥ
pauṣamāse vasantyete saptabhāskaramaṇḍale
lokaprakāśanārthāya vigravaryādhikāriṇaḥ
tvaṣṭātha jamadagniśca kambalotha tilottamā

items.text:
ब्रह्मोपेतोथ ऋतजिद्धृतराष्ट्रोथ सप्तमः
माघमासे वसन्त्येते सप्त मैत्रेय भास्करे
श्रूयतां चापरे सूर्ये फाल्गुने निवसन्ति ये
विष्णुरश्वतरो रम्भा सूर्यवर्चाश्च सत्यजित्
विश्वामित्रस्तथा रक्षो यज्ञोपेतो महामुने
मासेष्वेतेषु मैत्रेय वसन्त्येते तु सप्तकाः
items.tr:
brahmopetotha ṛtajiddhṛtarāṣṭrotha saptamaḥ
māghamāse vasantyete sapta maitreya bhāskare
śrūyatāṃ cāpare sūrye phālgune nivasanti ye
viṣṇuraśvataro rambhā sūryavarcāśca satyajit
viśvāmitrastathā rakṣo yajñopeto mahāmune
māseṣveteṣu maitreya vasantyete tu saptakāḥ

items.text:
सवितुर्मण्डले ब्रह्मन्विष्णुशक्त्युपबृंहिताः
स्तुवन्ति मुनयः सूर्यं गंधर्वैर्गीयते पुरः
नृत्यन्त्यप्सरसो यान्ति सूर्यस्यानुनिशाचराः
वहन्ति पन्नगा यक्षैः क्रियतेऽभीषुसंग्रहः
वालखित्यास्तथैवैनं परिवार्य समासते
सोयं सप्तगणः सूर्यमण्डले मुनिसत्तम
items.tr:
saviturmaṇḍale brahmanviṣṇuśaktyupabṛṃhitāḥ
stuvanti munayaḥ sūryaṃ gaṃdharvairgīyate puraḥ
nṛtyantyapsaraso yānti sūryasyānuniśācarāḥ
vahanti pannagā yakṣaiḥ kriyate'bhīṣusaṃgrahaḥ
vālakhityāstathaivainaṃ parivārya samāsate
soyaṃ saptagaṇaḥ sūryamaṇḍale munisattama

en_chapter: Parāçara said:—Between the extreme northern and southern points the sun has to travel in a year one hundred and eighty degrees, ascending and descending. His car is guided by divine Adityas, Rishis, Gandharvas, Apsarās, Yakshas, serpents, and Rākshasas. The Aditya Dhatri, the sage Pulastya, the Gandharva Tumburu, the nymph Kratusthalā, the Yaksha Rathakrit, the serpent Vāsuki and the Rākshasas Heti, live in the sun's car as its seven guardians, in the month of Madhu or Chaitra. In the month of Vaisākha or Mādhava the seven are Aryamat, Pulaha, Nāreda, Punjikāsthali Rathaujas, Kachanira and Praheti. In the month of Suchi or Jaistha they are Mitra, Atri, Hāhā Menā, Rathaswana, Takshaka, and Paurusheya. In the month of Sukra or Ashādha they are Varuna, Vasishtha, Huhu, Sahajanyā, Rathachitra, Nāga and Budha. In the month of Nabhas or Srāvana they are Indra, Angiras, Viswāvasu, Pramlochā, Srotas and Elapatra. In the month of Bhādrapada they are Vivaswat, Bhrigu, Ugrasena, Anumlocha, Apurana, Sankhapāla and Vyāghra. In the month of Aswin they are Pushan, Gautama, Suruchi, Ghritachi, Sushena, Dhananjaya and Vāta. In the month of Kārtik they are Parjanya, Bharadwāja, (another) Viswāvasu, Viswāchi, Senajit, Airāvata and Chāpa. In Agrahāyana or Mārgasirsha they are Ansu, Kasyapa, Chitrasena, Urvasi Tarkshya, Mahapadma and Vidyut. In the month of Pausha, Bhaga, Kratu, Urnayu, Purvachitti, Arishtanemi, Karkotaka, and Sphurja are the seven who live in the sun's orbit and distribute light throughout the universe. In the month of Māgha the seven are, Twashtri, Jāmadagni, Dhritarāshtra, Tillattamā, Ritajit, Kambala, and Brahmāpeta. In the month of Phālghuna those living in the sun are Vishnu, Visvamitra, Suryaverchchas, Rambhā, Satyajit, Aswatara and Yajnāpeta.

In this wise, O Maitreya, a group of seven celestial beings supported by the energy of Vishnu lives, during the several months, in the orb of the sun. The sage chants his glory, the Gandharva sings and the nymph dances before him; the night-rangers attend upon his steps; the serpent harnesses his horses and the Yaksha trims the reins and the Bālakhilyas surround his chariot. O foremost of Munis, these seven groups, residing in the suns, orb at their respective seasons, become the instrumentals in the distribution of cold, heat and rain.
